user.title: Connect to Cam-Wise
user.description: Enter the LAN address of Cam-Wise.

data_description.host: The local hostname or IP address of the Cam-Wise app, without http:// or a path.
data_description.port: The local API port exposed by Cam-Wise.

confirm.title: Cam-Wise found
confirm.description:
Cam-Wise was found at {host}:{port}. Version: {version}. Environment: {environment}.

Check that this is the intended installation. WorkTest is a separate test environment; only confirm it if you deliberately want to connect to it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Cam-Wise
reconfigure.description: Update the LAN address for this Cam-Wise installation. Camera settings are preserved. Add a different installation separately.

data_description.host: The new local hostname or IP address for the same Cam-Wise installation.
data_description.port: The local API port exposed by Cam-Wise.

pair.title: Confirm in Cam-Wise Desktop
pair.description:
**Comparison code: {code}**

Open Cam-Wise Desktop and compare this code with its request. Choose Allow only if the codes match. Then submit this form. HTTP on your trusted home network can be intercepted; do not use a public or guest network.

error.cannot_connect: Cam-Wise is unreachable. Check that Desktop is running and LAN access was explicitly enabled. If its address changed, update the connection using Reconfigure.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address without a path or query string.
error.unsupported_api_version: This Cam-Wise API version is not supported.
error.different_device: This address belongs to a different Cam-Wise installation.
error.approval_required: Cam-Wise has not approved this request. Compare the code and choose Allow in Desktop before submitting here. If the request expired or was denied, open a new pairing window in Desktop and select New request here.
error.pairing_unavailable: Cam-Wise is reachable but cannot accept a new request: another request is pending or the pairing window expired. Deny the old request in Desktop or let it expire. Then open a new pairing window and try a New request here.

abort.already_configured: This Cam-Wise installation is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Cam-Wise is unreachable. Check that Desktop is running and LAN access was explicitly enabled. If its address changed, update the connection using Reconfigure.
abort.discovery_expired: The discovered Cam-Wise installation is no longer available. Add it manually or wait for discovery to run again.
abort.unsupported_api_version: The discovered Cam-Wise API version is not supported.

init.title: Recommended link

data_description.use_recommended: Use Cam-Wise's recommended Home Assistant camera and event entities.
data_description.choose_entities: Open the manual entity selection form instead of using the recommendation.

advanced.title: Choose other entities
advanced.description: Advanced fallback. Choose which Home Assistant entities may create Cam-Wise review items.

data_description.camera_entity_id: Camera entity used as the source camera in Cam-Wise review items.
data_description.recording_entity_id: Entity that exposes the latest media identifier when a recording is ready.
data_description.motion_entity_id: Entity whose state changes indicate motion events.
data_description.ding_entity_id: Entity whose state changes indicate doorbell events.
data_description.recording_camera_entities: Allow these cameras for existing video downloads. Each camera retains its own Cam-Wise dataset, model and queue. Enable receiving separately per camera in Cam-Wise.

error.invalid_mapping: Choose existing entities with the correct domain and distinct event roles.

recording_desktop_update.title: Update Cam-Wise Desktop for recorded videos
recording_desktop_update.description: This Desktop version does not support the reliable recording-time contract. Update Desktop before enabling automatic recorded-video intake. Existing cameras, datasets, models and Review items are preserved.
